ssh sdfiana025 'cd /sdf/scratch/lcls/ds/prj/prjcwang31/scratch/main/agentify-lcls2/work/proof15/../../wt-final; git log -1 --format="%H %ad %s" --date=iso | cut -c1-138; echo "local changes: $(git status --short | wc -l)"; date -u +%FT%TZ'

ssh sdfiana025 /sdf/scratch/lcls/ds/prj/prjcwang31/scratch/main/agentify-lcls2/work/proof15/web15_up.sh web3   # one Slurm step on sdfada011 (job 44016690), under its node lock: a fresh CPU DAQ and the web GUI
